response.sql: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), average_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS value FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(lt.total_cost) AS average_total_cost, SUM(lt.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(lt.total_cost - a.value) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS lt CROSS JOIN average_total AS a WHERE lt.total_cost > a.value
